metadata.official_project_title: Nghiên cứu và xây dựng công cụ phát hiện ảnh và tài liệu giả mạo sinh bởi AI.

attempts.prompt: a photo of a retail receipt, crisp clear printed text displaying '350,000', matching authentic thermal receipt paper texture, sharp dark printed typography, clean alignment
attempts.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted text, illegible fonts, messy background, watermarks, artifacts, colored stains, handwritten
attempts.rationale: Evaluate numerical glyph replacement on thermal paper texture without disturbing neighboring line items.

attempts.prompt: a high resolution photo of a store receipt, sharp printed text displaying 'Magnum Gold Almond', matching receipt typography and texture, uniform lighting, crisp black font
attempts.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted text, illegible fonts, crooked baseline, stains, artifacts
attempts.rationale: Evaluate long alphanumeric product name substitution on high-resolution receipt.

attempts.prompt: a photo of a retail receipt, clean blank receipt paper texture, subtle paper grain, uniform off-white surface, no text, completely erased
attempts.negative_prompt: text, numbers, letters, blurry stains, dark spots, ghosting, visible outlines, artifacts
attempts.rationale: Evaluate complete semantic erasure of discount subtotal line with seamless paper background restoration.

attempts.prompt: a photo of a retail receipt, clean blank receipt paper texture, subtle vertical paper fiber, uniform flat lighting, seamless empty paper, no text
attempts.negative_prompt: text, numbers, letters, ghost glyphs, smudges, stains, artifacts, border lines
attempts.rationale: Evaluate erasure of tax line between subtotal and grand total while preserving surrounding table layout.
